definitions.gloss: custom-made item; made-to-order product; special order
definitions.explanation: An item that is specially ordered or made according to customer specifications, as opposed to ready-made items.

examples.japanese: {注文品|ちゅうもんひん}は{返品|へんぴん}できません。
この{家具|かぐ}は{注文品|ちゅうもんひん}なので{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: This furniture is a custom order, so it will take time.

examples.japanese: {注文品|ちゅうもんひん}の{受|う}け{取|と}りには{身分証|みぶんしょう}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: ID is required to pick up custom orders.

notes:
{注文品|ちゅうもんひん} is commonly seen in retail and e-commerce contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- {既製品|きせいひん}: ready-made product
- {特注品|とくちゅうひん}: specially ordered item (often implies customization)
- オーダーメイド: custom-made (from English)
- {受注生産|じゅちゅうせいさん}: made-to-order production

USAGE:
{注文品|ちゅうもんひん} often has return restrictions. Signs saying 「{注文品|ちゅうもんひん}につき{返品|へんぴん}{不可|ふか}」 (custom orders non-returnable) are common.
